name: Orx
lore: As the Void Rifts connected far-off worlds together, the Orx discovered, to their immense glee, that there were other things in the universe to fight, aside from just eachother. Picking up their scrappy war-choppas and slugga gunz, they followed their warbosses through the Rifts in search of good clean fun, in the form of brawls and battles. After all, what else would other alienz be there for, if not to fight?

rules.name: YAAAARGH!
rules.lore: The infamous war cry of the Orx is known and feared throughout the universe. When it echoes across the battlefield, bellowed from thousands of barbaric mouths, even the most stoic warriors fear the onslaught to come.
rules.text:
Once per battle, at the start of a battle round, call a YAAAARGH. If you do, until the start of the next battle round:
* Your +Orx+ units are eligible to both Advance and Charge in the same turn.
* Add 1 to the =swords= Attacks and =hand-fist= Strength properties of melee weapons equipped by your +Orx+ models.
* Your +Orx+ models have an =shield-plus= Invulnerable Save trait of 5+.
